content.short: Sad Cards is a hand-illustrated deck of cards, with 5 different rarities.
content.description:
Garlic Soul aim to bring our art and passions to Cardano.

Sad Cards is our first project, 54 hand-illustrated cards with 100 copies each and 5 different rarities. Each card is shipped with our utility coin "Garlic Coin".
